title: Buildings carry baked masonry, plaster or wood maps
note: Buildings carry baked masonry, plaster or wood maps from the project's material baker, never flat colour.
intent: Buildings are the largest surfaces in the frame, so a flat colour on them is the first thing the taste judge names. Bake three or four wall kinds in a material module (for example src/materials.js) (stone, render, timber, brick) with tiling chosen so the pattern does not repeat visibly across one facade, and pick per building from a seeded rng. Vary the base colour slightly between buildings so a row does not read as one extruded block, and keep the map on every mesh tagged building, gable ends and side walls included.

check.note: Buildings carry baked masonry/plaster/wood maps from the project's material baker, never flat colour.

port: The buildings facet applies a material kind per building at construction time from the project's material baker; no MeshStandardMaterial with only a colour survives on a building.
